tail-of-the-dragon-cherohala-skyway.title: US 129 Deals Gap · Cherohala Skyway
tail-of-the-dragon-cherohala-skyway.slogan: 318 curves in 11 miles, then the empty high road back.
tail-of-the-dragon-cherohala-skyway.story: Deals Gap is famous for a reason and infamous for another: 318 curves packed into eleven miles, heavily policed, and photographed by professionals at the bends. Ride it once for the story, then take the Cherohala Skyway back - longer, higher, emptier and arguably the better road.

waypoints.name: Deals Gap
waypoints.advice: Deals Gap is where the day begins. Reckon on about 2 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is US 129 Deals Gap summit.

waypoints.name: US 129 Deals Gap summit
waypoints.advice: You top out at 610 m here. Next is Tapoco / Cheoah Dam, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Tapoco / Cheoah Dam
waypoints.advice: 51 km in you reach Tapoco / Cheoah Dam. You lose 270 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Robbinsville, climbing 280 m.

waypoints.name: Robbinsville
waypoints.advice: A pump at 77 km in. The road climbs 280 m on the way up to it, steadily. Next is High point near Robbinsville, climbing 930 m.

waypoints.name: High point near Robbinsville
waypoints.advice: High point near Robbinsville tops the climb at 1550 m. The road climbs 930 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 8 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Tellico Plains, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Tellico Plains
waypoints.advice: Tellico Plains comes up 128 km in. You lose 1280 m on the way down to it, hard. Next is back to Deals Gap, climbing 310 m.

waypoints.name: back to Deals Gap
waypoints.advice: back to Deals Gap closes the day. The road climbs 310 m over at least 37 km before it, steadily.

scenicChapters.title: US 129 Deals Gap
scenicChapters.narrative: For 14 km this is US 129 Deals Gap, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Cherohala Skyway
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 27 km. 930 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.

scenicChapters.title: Cherohala Skyway
scenicChapters.narrative: 33 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
